            WHERE event_time>=TIMESTAMP '2025-01-15 00:00:00'
              AND event_time<TIMESTAMP '2025-01-16 00:00:00' AND business_date=DATE '2025-01-15'

unpartitioned_date.sql:
SELECT count(*) events,sum(units) units FROM lake.simulation.sim_10g_20260906_unpartitioned
            WHERE event_time>=TIMESTAMP '2025-01-15 00:00:00'
              AND event_time<TIMESTAMP '2025-01-16 00:00:00'

partitioned_date.sql:
SELECT count(*) events,sum(units) units FROM lake.simulation.sim_10g_20260906_partitioned
            WHERE event_time>=TIMESTAMP '2025-01-15 00:00:00'

before_compaction.sql:
SELECT count(*) events,sum(units) units,
            sum(cast(xxhash64(trace_payload) as decimal(38,0))) payload_checksum FROM lake.simulation.sim_10g_20260906_partitioned

after_compaction.sql:
SELECT count(*) events,sum(units) units,
            sum(cast(xxhash64(trace_payload) as decimal(38,0))) payload_checksum FROM lake.simulation.sim_10g_20260906_partitioned
